Archival Dispatch: 25 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Big D Jamboree, Office Wife, WWII News, and Seeing Ear Theater

Batch 53 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 53 resolves 25 historical radio broadcasts across rockabilly/honky-tonk stage radio, Golden Age daytime serials, pivotal World War II news transmissions, and modern audio drama: 8 live Saturday night stage recordings from Dallas's famous Big D Jamboree (1956–1958, broadcast live from the Sportatorium on KRLD featuring Lefty Frizzell, Ronnie Dawson, Jerry Reed, and the Belew Twins), 8 consecutive chapters of the 1940 daytime soap opera Office Wife, 8 vital historical audio transmissions from WWII News (including Edward R. Murrow's rooftop live reporting during the London Blitz and wartime propaganda broadcasts), and a modern sci-fi drama from Seeing Ear Theater.
